[Unit]
Description=Nonnegative CT alternating NNLS and multiplicative updates at matched view budgets
ConditionPathExists=!/home/tony/frames_ct_2detect_20261104/spectral_balls/expanded/nonnegative_baselines/report_update.json

[Service]
Type=exec
WorkingDirectory=/home/tony/frames_ct_2detect_20261104/spectral_balls/expanded/nonnegative_baselines
ExecStart=/home/tony/zofw_experiments/.venv/bin/python -u /home/tony/frames_ct_2detect_20261104/spectral_balls/expanded/nonnegative_baselines/frozen_sources/nonnegative_campaign.py --root /home/tony/frames_ct_2detect_20261104/spectral_balls/expanded/nonnegative_baselines --publish
Nice=10
IOSchedulingClass=best-effort
IOSchedulingPriority=7
AllowedCPUs=0,2,4,6
Environment=PYTHONPATH=/home/tony/frames_ct_2detect_20261104/deps
Environment=PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
Environment=OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
Environment=OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
Environment=MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
Environment=NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1
Environment=VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1
Environment=BLIS_NUM_THREADS=1
Environment=MPLBACKEND=Agg
Environment=PATH=/home/tony/.local/share/latex-tools/default-compiler/bin:/home/tony/zofw_experiments/.venv/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin
StandardOutput=append:/home/tony/frames_ct_2detect_20261104/spectral_balls/expanded/nonnegative_baselines/campaign.log
StandardError=inherit
Restart=no

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
description: Persistent four-worker campaign with single-thread BLAS and pinned CPUs 0,2,4,6.
